description: Search GASTAT's Saudi Arabia statistics catalog (~2,600 indicators: population, employment/unemployment, GDP, consumer prices/inflation, foreign trade, and more) by keyword in English or Arabic. Returns indicator ids + bilingual titles + reporting frequency; pass an id to gastat_series for the full time series. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for finding an official Saudi statistic by topic.

term.description: Keyword(s) in English or Arabic, e.g. "unemployment", "consumer price index", "population", "التضخم".

title: Gastat Search
